quarterly_data.signal: Portfolio change: DENSO requested termination of the September 1, 2025 agreement to transfer its spark plug and exhaust gas sensor (oxygen sensor and air-fuel ratio sensor) business to Niterra, and the two companies agreed not to proceed and to sign a termination agreement; DENSO says demand for diverse powertrains has persisted longer than initially expected and that continuing to operate the business is optimal under its 'CORE 2030' plan.
